name: Sledcom 2023–26 — is the official the defendant? (stratum B, 20 cards)
instructions: [2026-10-22 (GOLD-D4): the 20 stratum-B cards only (defendant_is_official rows, bar 0.85). Stratum A is scored from the ARR1010 silver plus a third referee.] Read the Sledcom press-release text (title + first 2,500 characters, exactly what the classifier saw). Is a GOVERNMENT OFFICIAL (elected official, civil servant, police/MVD, prosecutor, judge, military officer, head of a state institution; NOT a private businessman) a DEFENDANT / SUSPECT / ACCUSED in this case? If NO, say what role the official has (victim / mentioned only / none). Judge from the text alone; the link is there only if the text is cut mid-sentence. 'Unclear' is fine.
